answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in sparrow, checked in vault, and ferrous publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 14 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4364 identities would post 3614 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
